description: DocsAgent shell error codes. Every tool failure is returned as an MCP result with isError=true and a JSON body {"error":{"code","message","suggested_call"?}}. suggested_call is a tool-call suggestion the agent can retry directly: {"tool","args"?,"note"?}.

target_not_supported.trigger: Requested target is not supported by the source

suggested_call.note: Retry with the first target reported as supported by list_sources

include_not_supported.trigger: Requested include section is not supported by the source

suggested_call.note: Retry with the includes reported as supported by list_sources

missing_query.trigger: get_content with mode=passages but no query

no_content.trigger: Item not found or item has no readable attachment

orphan_note.trigger: add_note produced a note without parentItem; the write was rolled back

capability_not_supported.trigger: Tool or parameter uses a capability the source does not declare

missing_input.trigger: import_item called without paths or identifiers (exactly one is required)

core_unavailable.trigger: DocsAgent Core is not reachable at http://{coreHost}:{httpPort}/rpc (connection refused)

core_timeout.trigger: DocsAgent Core did not answer within the request timeout

index_building.trigger: The index for the target source is currently being built

index_unavailable.trigger: The index for the target source is missing or damaged

web_api_error.trigger: Zotero local API or Zotero Web API request failed

auth_failed.trigger: Zotero Web API rejected the configured API key

unauthorized.trigger: Remote (Streamable HTTP) request without valid credentials

forbidden.trigger: Remote request authenticated but not permitted to use this tool

session_expired.trigger: Remote MCP session is no longer valid; re-initialize
